items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Well, I'll tell you now, Buddy Rich is my drummer.

ctx.x: Right. I wasn't talking about copying but there are certain drummers that I'm sure influence us; maybe not the same ones and I'm sure there are guitarists that have influenced Crook and vocalists that had influenced him.
Well, I'll tell you now, Buddy Rich is my drummer. I like his playing, yeah, Buddy Rich.
